items.title: Terry Clark — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I didn’t know him real, real well, but I know he was a jazz buff.

ctx.x: Ezra Charles was a big jazz fan. Did you know Ezra Charles?
Yeah. He was supposed to be a bass player, but I didn’t know him real, real well, but I know he was a jazz buff.
Did you recruit other people for Basie? Did you bring other people into the band?
